description: This file is a bash script that generates an SDK Repository XML based on provided input files. It processes archive files (like ZIPs), extracts properties, and creates an XML document conforming to a specified schema. The script handles parsing of properties, validation, and XML generation for SDK components like toolchains, platforms, samples, and add-ons.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug messages to standard error.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs error messages and invokes usage.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: check_enum
methods.description: Validates whether a value matches one of the expected enumeration terms.

methods.name: uses_new_host_os
methods.description: Determines if the schema version supports new host OS attributes.

methods.name: parse_attributes
methods.description: Parses properties files to extract relevant attributes based on schema version and attribute list.

methods.name: output_attributes
methods.description: Outputs parsed attributes into XML format, handling nested elements and revisions.

methods.name: write_full_revision
methods.description: Formats revision strings (e.g., major.minor.micro) into structured XML.

methods.name: needs_full_revision
methods.description: Checks if certain revision elements require full revision details.
